generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
network: No internet connection. Check your signal and try again.

auth.emailInUse: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in.
auth.weakPassword: Password too weak. Use at least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
auth.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.requiresRecentLogin: For your security, please confirm your identity again.
auth.providerUnavailable: This sign-in method is not available on this device.

pets.saveFailed: Could not save the pet. Please try again.
pets.photoFailed: Could not upload the photo. The pet was saved; try adding the photo again.
pets.photoPending: The server did not confirm saving the pet in time, so the photo was not uploaded. The pet is only on this device for now. When the connection is back, open the pet, tap Edit and add the photo.
pets.deleteFailed: Could not delete the pet. Please try again.
pets.deleteNotOwner: Could not delete: the server did not find this pet in your account. This happens when the pet was saved only on this device (no connection to the server) or when the emulators were restarted. Close the app, clear its data and register the pet again.

account.deleteFailed: Could not delete the account right now. Nothing was fully erased; please try again.

permissions.cameraDenied: No camera access. You can allow it in your device settings.
permissions.photosDenied: No photo access. You can allow it in your device settings.
